title: Clinical Decision Support
summary: The CDS Five Rights, alert fatigue, knowledge representation (Arden, GLIF, modern guideline-as-service), and how to design CDS that clinicians actually use without breaking their workflow.
learningOutcomes: State the CDS Five Rights and apply them to a real CDS design.
Explain alert fatigue at the cognitive, workflow, and metric levels.
Compare Arden Syntax, GLIF, and modern FHIR-based CDS Hooks.
Design a CDS intervention for a given clinical problem and defend each design choice.
Recognize the failure modes of CDS that look right on paper and break in practice.
